text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text:
I couldn't get any good feel for it,
running completely flat, with no wind in my sails at all...

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text: There is nothing to call it other than my own lack of ability.
choice_data_list: Next time, let's whip up a gale!
We need to raise our overall ability.

Understood, next time I will bring the wind to the track—
no, a wind as fierce as a storm...!

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text: Yes... I shall dedicate myself to even further training.
choice_data_list: Yeah, let's give it our all together!
Yeah, let's do our best together!

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text: Together... That's right. The two of us will grow stronger together.

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text: Yes. Next time, the two of us will seize the wind of victory.
